query:
SELECT 
  p.id,
  p.name,
  p.subcategoryId,
  sc.name as subcategoryName
FROM products p
LEFT JOIN subcategories sc ON p.subcategoryId = sc.id
WHERE p.name LIKE '%Heineken%' OR p.name LIKE '%Jack%'
LIMIT 5
